hero.title: Document Intelligence for Notaries
hero.subtitle: DocumentoIQ helps analyze, extract and organize information from deeds and other notarial documents, reducing review times while always keeping the final decision in the hands of the notary.
hero.microcopy: Designed to understand documentation specific to the notarial environment.

whatIs.title: Why a specialization for notaries?
whatIs.description: Deeds, powers of attorney, records and other notarial documents require an understanding of their specific document structure and legal context. DocumentoIQ incorporates specialized document logic to organize information and facilitate its review.
whatIs.disclaimer: DocumentoIQ assists the document process; legal interpretation and the final decision always remain in the hands of the notary.

howItWorks.title: How does DocumentoIQ for Notaries work?

step1.title: 1. Document upload
step1.description: Upload deeds, powers of attorney, records and other notarial documents in digital or scanned format.

step2.title: 2. Specialized document understanding
step2.intro: DocumentoIQ analyzes the document, identifies relevant information and organizes it automatically.

step3.title: 3. Review and validation
step3.description: Review the organized information, perform the necessary validations and continue with your document process.

benefits.title: What does DocumentoIQ bring to a notary office?
benefits.description: DocumentoIQ combines document specialization for notaries with capabilities designed to integrate naturally into your operation.

business.title: Operational benefits
items: Keeps control in the hands of the notary

useCases.title: Documents understood by the Notaries specialization
useCases.description: DocumentoIQ incorporates document logic to understand different types of notarial documentation and facilitate their review. Some of them are:

acts.title: Public deeds
acts.description: Identifies appearing parties, legal acts, properties and other relevant elements of a public deed.

powers.title: Powers of attorney
powers.description: Organizes key information from general and special powers of attorney to facilitate their review.

deeds.title: Wills
deeds.description: Facilitates document review through structured information from the will.

wills.title: Protocols and records
wills.description: Analyzes the document structure to present information clearly and in an organized manner.
